evidence.title: Sponsored: Why speed to power starts before the grid

summary: Tech companies developing large‑scale artificial‑intelligence models are seeking to secure dedicated power sources and on‑site generation to reduce latency and cost, effectively starting their “speed to power” phase before relying on the public grid. This shift underscores the growing importance of energy infrastructure in AI development and the need for flexible, resilient power solutions.
title: AI firms prioritize early power supply to accelerate compute before grid connections
